tldr: Mars through the 2nd house brings focus to money, resources, values, and self-worth.
body: Mars transiting the 2nd house energizes money, resources, values, and self-worth. For about six weeks, drive, heat, conflict, desire, and action move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is an activation transit: it brings momentum and courage, but also heat that needs a clear outlet.
business: Mars supports earning and resourcing: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Impulsiveness, conflict, burnout, or equating worth with what is owned or earned.
advice: Aim the fire in the 2nd house deliberately. Work with money, resources, values, and self-worth without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from Marie Satori house-transit material.
